title: Proportional Relationships as Lines Review Test
description: Connect proportional relationships to lines through the origin and equations of the form y = mx.

questions.questionText: A proportional relationship includes the origin and (2, 4). Which equation represents the graph?
questions.explanation: A proportional relationship goes through the origin and has equation y = mx, where m = y/x.

questions.questionText: A line through the origin also passes through (3, 9). Which equation matches this proportional relationship?
questions.explanation: A proportional relationship goes through the origin and has equation y = mx, where m = y/x.
